jobs.description:
About the roleAs Service Delivery & Supplier Manager, you'll own the end-to-end service lifecycle for our D3 and OMS platforms — from solution validation through onboarding, transition, go-live, and business-as-usual.You'll govern service levels and delivery performance globally, define and continuously improve our service delivery framework and governance structures, and own supplier and technology procurement end to end — from sourcing and negotiation through contract lifecycle, renewals, and cost optimization.You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Customer Success to keep our services and supplier relationships running smoothly, while also shaping the frameworks, governance, and processes that let this function scale as we grow. You'll be the person who ensures service levels are met, escalations are handled with structure, and supplier and procurement decisions serve both commercial and operational goals.This role suits someone who's comfortable moving between governance, operations, and commercial negotiation, and who enjoys owning things end-to-end.
Your Responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end service lifecycle from solution validation through onboarding, transition, go-live, and BAU, ensuring reliable delivery within a multi-vendor SaaS ecosystem.
• Lead service delivery and performance management for D3 platforms, ensuring agreed levels of availability, resilience, stability, and service quality across global environments.
• Define and continuously improve the service delivery framework, governance structures, and delivery processes, ensuring effective integration with incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
• Govern Service Level Management (SLAs, KPIs, OLAs), including performance monitoring, reporting, escalations, and continuous improvement across clients, internal teams, and external providers.
• Attend customer service reviews, governance forums, and service-related escalations and integrate outcomes into the existing processes.
• Own operational supplier and outsourcing management, including supplier governance, performance management, escalations, remediation, and continuous improvement.
• Own technology procurement and commercial supplier management, including sourcing, supplier selection, negotiations, contract lifecycle and renewals, and cost optimization.
• Ensure service delivery and supplier operations adhere to applicable risk, compliance, information security, and audit requirements, maintaining required controls and evidence while supporting the responsible oversight functions.
• Drive continuous improvement and evolution of the service delivery and supplier management operating model, leveraging cross-client and operational insights to support scalability, automation, and business growth.

Preferred qualifications
• Several years of experience in service delivery, service management, or IT operations, ideally within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
• Proven experience owning supplier and vendor management end to end — governance, performance management, escalations, and remediation.
• Experience with technology procurement and commercial contract management, including sourcing, negotiation, contract lifecycle, and cost optimization.
• Working knowledge of service management practices such as incident, problem, change, and release management.
• Experience defining and governing SLAs, KPIs, and OLAs, with a track record of turning performance data into action.
• Comfortable engaging directly with clients and stakeholders in governance forums, service reviews, and escalations.
• Familiarity with risk, compliance, information security, and audit requirements in a regulated or enterprise environment.
• Strong analytical and process-improvement mindset, with experience evolving service and supplier operating models at scale.
• Fluency in English is required.

Nice to have
• German language skills are a plus.
• Understanding of cloud, infrastructure, networking, and modern application/platform environments, sufficient to effectively manage technical suppliers.
• Knowledge of financial markets.
• Familiar with Jira/Confluence.
• Familiar with ITIL and/or ISO 27001, ISAE 3402, or SOC 2.

What we offer as an employer
• Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.
• Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.

jobs.occupation: Team Lead Customer Success (all genders) (Kaufmännische Fachkraft)
jobs.employer_name: DIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH
jobs.description:
About the roleAre you passionate about building high-performing teams, deepening client trust, and turning complex software into a tool people rely on every day?As Team Lead Customer Success, you'll take ownership of our Customer Success function for D3 and OMS clients — banks, traders and technical teams who depend on our systems to price, manage and distribute FX Forward and Swap prices around the clock. You'll lead a team of four responsible for day-to-day client support, build the processes and product expertise that are shared across the team, and shape a more proactive way of working with clients.This is not a role where you inherit a finished machine. You'll inherit a strong product, demanding expert users, a good team, and a function that needs clear ownership, deep product expertise, strong tooling, and a proactive way of working. Working closely with Product, Sales, and Engineering, you'll help define what a modern, efficient Customer Success function looks like for our market.This is a hands-on builder role for someone comfortable with ambiguity, who enjoys getting close to the product and the client as much as leading a team.
Your Responsibilities
• Lead and grow the Customer Success team responsible for D3 and OMS clients, taking on full people-management responsibility.
• Own the quality of day-to-day client support, making sure questions are answered quickly, clearly, and to a consistently high standard.
• Own support escalation, ensuring complex, urgent, or sensitive cases move through the organisation in a structured way instead of bouncing between people.
• Build the team's product expertise so that a growing share of D3 and OMS questions can be answered directly, without relying on Product, Engineering, or long-standing individual experts.
• Own onboarding from a Customer Success perspective, so new clients and users understand the product and are set up for success from day one.
• Develop a more proactive way of working with clients — anticipating issues before clients raise them, and identifying where they are not using D3 or OMS to its full potential, reaching out with suggestions rather than only reacting to requests.
• Make client knowledge visible internally by documenting client setup, usage, stakeholders, infrastructure, and recurring issues, rather than letting it live in emails or individual heads.
• Create a structured feedback loop into Product, surfacing patterns, friction, and recurring issues from client interactions, not just direct feature requests.
• Help define and improve the tools, processes, and reporting used by Customer Success, including systems such as Dynamics, Confluence, and Jira.
• Contribute to a clear, shared view of client health, including key users, setup, risks, and commercial opportunities, working closely with Sales.
• Speak directly and frequently with traders, desk heads, application owners, and technical stakeholders at client banks.

Preferred qualifications
• Several years of experience leading a Customer Success, Support, or Client Services team, ideally in enterprise software or fintech.
• A proven ability to build structure, process, and ownership in a function that is still evolving, rather than only maintaining an existing setup.
• Strong technical aptitude and the ability to develop deep expertise in a complex software product like D3. This is not an engineering role, but you need to be comfortable with technical detail and credible with sophisticated users.
• Enough financial-market understanding to grasp why D3 exists, what problem it solves, and what our traders need from it.
• Comfortable engaging directly with senior, demanding stakeholders such as traders and desk heads, as well as technical and operations teams at banks.
• Strong track record of managing escalations and keeping complex cases moving through an organisation without losing ownership.
• Experience building or improving tooling, automation, AI-assisted workflows, reporting, and documentation practices within a support or Customer Success function.
• Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with Product, Sales, and Engineering.
• Fluency in English is required.

Nice to have Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:
• FX, Capital Markets, FICC, Treasury, or electronic trading environments.
• Previous exposure to OMS or similar trading systems.
• Enterprise SaaS support or Customer Success in a technically complex product.
• Experience building a Customer Success function in a small, expert team, with a hands-on approach to clients, product, and day-to-day operations.
• Familiarity with SaaS environments and technical operations — infrastructure, connectivity, system monitoring — even though this role does not own technical operations.
• CRM or ticketing systems such as Dynamics, Confluence, Jira, or Teams.

What we offer as an employer
• Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.
• Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.
• Be part of an international workforce: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.
• Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.
• Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.
• Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.

jobs.description:
The Research Institute Children's Cancer Centre at the University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf is looking for a highly motivated research assistant (PhD student) in the Computational Pediatric Oncology working group (headed by Prof. Dr. Michael Bockmayr) starting 01.11.2026. A later start can be accomodated in principle. We actively support and offer the chance to pursue a PhD alongside the project.
This position is part of a BMFTR-funded Junior Research Consortium conducted in close cooperation with the TU Berlin (Machine Learning Group/Dr. Mina Jamshidi Idaji) and the LMU München (Computational and Molecular Pathology/Prof. Dr. Philipp Jurmeister). The project focuses on developing novel ML methods for multimodal learning in computer-aided diagnostics. The goal is to integrate histopathological, clinical, and molecular data to optimize AI-based decision-making tools in oncology.
Strong individualized support is guaranteed throughout the entire period. In addition, you can expect a motivated and dynamic team of physicians, natural scientists, bioinformaticians, technical assistants, and students at the Research Institute, who are investigating pediatric cancers as part of various projects and with different approaches. Your tasks:

Development and evaluation of clinically relevant multimodal classification algorithms using machine learning methods based on image data and high-dimensional omics datasets
Integration of histological, molecular (genomics, epigenomics, transcriptomics at the bulk and single-cell levels), and clinical data
Close collaboration with partners and other research groups at the Children’s Cancer Center
Presentation of research results at international conferences and publication as first author in recognized journals

This position is temporary for three years due to third-party funding and project duration.
Proven programming experience, especially in Python, good knowledge of ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Programming experience in R is a plus
Excellent knowledge of current machine learning methods
Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across disciplines
Proficiency in written and spoken English; familiarity with German is a plus
Experience with representation learning, transformer architectures, and explainable AI (XAI) is a plus
Knowledge of omics data processing and basic molecular biology is a plus but not mandatory, as we care more about your computational skills
Knowledge of UNIX-based operating systems and version control software is desirable

We look forward to receiving a detailed application including a letter of motivation, CV, references, degree certificates, transcript of records and, if possible, links to code examples, theses or publications.

jobs.occupation: Scientist for the development of the German EOSC‑Node (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Scientist for the development of the German EOSC‑Node

Limited: 2 years | Start: earliest possible | ID: FHMA022/2026 | Deadline: 03.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The DESY Information Technology (IT) division participates in a wide range of high-profile national and European projects, evaluating and developing innovative IT technologies. One of its key activities is the establishment of the German EOSC Node in collaboration with ten leading research institutions across Germany as part of the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI). This initiative requires close coordination across more than 300 German universities and research institutions, as well as with national and European research infrastructures.
To support this ambitious endeavour, we are seeking a scientist with expertise in modern web technologies, particularly the development of user-facing web portals and backend services. The successful candidate will be motivated to contribute to the design, development, and operation of these technologies within the evolving European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) ecosystem.

About your role:

- You will contribute to the overall architecture and the design of the German NFDI EOSC Node
- You will coordinate the selection and methodology for developing a service portfolio compatible with existing requirements for the EOSC Node
- You will enhance and deploy a portal for accessing Web Services for the EOSC Node
- You will ensure that the representation of service records is harmonized and aligned with interoperability specifications in the EOSC
- You will participate in regular project meetings, workshops and conferences, both online and in person, and you will contribute to regular reports towards the project management

About you:

- You have completed a master's degree in computer science, physics or related subjects
- You have good knowledge of Web Technologies and at least one modern programming language
- Familiarity with modern cloud technologies, such as CI/CD and Kubernetes, is beneficial
- Experience with user-facing web portals, REST APIs and/or backend development is a plus
- You have good spoken and written command of the English Ianguage
- You are a collaborative team player who enjoys working in large, international teams
- You are open to travel

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work-life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information, please contact Tim Wetzel at +49 40 8998‑2911 (https://tel:+494089982911)  **(Tim.Wetzel@desy.de (https://mailto:Tim.Wetzel@desy.de) ).**

Bachelor student (d/f/m) in the field of Quality Management / Behavioral Science, working title of thesis "Quality NC Eradication – Behavioral Quality Management (Nudging)".

Your focus lies on establishing robust data models to serve as a "single source of truth" and using them as a foundation to automate engineering system models.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours (min. 28 hours / week) and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Guide the introduction of MBSE as a development method for complex airframe projects.
- Co-create the MBSE Framework (method, language, tools) as a platform architecture for a distributed development environment in alignment with our Digital Agenda.
- Manage the technical MBSE environment and extend it to other product development activities.

- Evaluate and advance modeling methods and tools in alignment with corporate development requirements and partners.

- Continuously increase know-how in wide band gap wafer processes
- Investigate competitor processes and technologies
- Build up and maintain internal contacts
- Conduct process optimization projects, setting up new manufacturing processes in own wafer fabs or in foundries abroad.

- Ideally several years of experience in this field
- Knowledge of semiconductor devices with special focus on SiC MOSFET and GaN HEMT
- Experience with implementing semiconductor manufacturing processes especially for wide band gap materials into industrial environment
- Hands-on experience in wafer processing with the required equipment
- Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken

- Team player with a strong drive to achieve success

jobs.occupation: Group Account Manager HPC, B&W (d/f/m) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Group Account Manager HPC, B&W (d/w/m)

JOB PURPOSE

As Group Account Manager, you will lead the commercial strategy and development of the HPC and B&W categories across strategically important customers. You will be responsible for driving sustainable growth, shaping long-term customer partnerships and leading a high-performing Key Account Management team to deliver ambitious business results.
Working cross-functionally and internationally, you will translate market opportunities, shopper insights and customer needs into winning growth strategies that create value for both our customers and Unilever. You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters — for people and the planet.

Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger.

This role is temporary from September 2026 until February 2027 (total of 6 months)

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, deploy and monitor the HPC, B&W customer and omni-channel strategy with 3 years Joint Business Planning scope for assigned top accounts.
• Lead, inspire and develop an experienced and diverse Key Account Management Team and get the maximum out of it by over-achieving commercial business targets (top-/bottomline, shares).
• Influence key stakeholders internally/externally to unlock full customer growth potential and get the required support, cross-functionally and in international teams.
• Drive fact-based decision making by leveraging market, customer and shopper insights to optimize investments, allocate resources and unlock growth opportunities.
• Internal/external heavyweight stakeholder management by building profound business partnerships based on innovative Thought- & Action-Leadership model.
• Forsee future trends and convert into solid strategies and tactics with a focus on efficient deployment across all types of stakeholders.
• Build, deploy and monitor the annual negotiation process. Use Integrated Business Planning process to unlock your internal/external stakeholder’s interests.
• Step-up and inspire Commercial Team’s as vibrant and agile CBD influencer.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• University degree in Business Management, Sales, Marketing
• Min. 3-5 years Commercial and CD frontline experience (e.g. Senior Key Account Manager, Senior CSP Manager) in Germany; FMCG preferred
• Min. 2 years Category Strategy & Planning or Brand Building management experience
• H&B Channel experience, including international sales experience
• Profound and certified Category Management skills
• Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop high-performing teams in a dynamic and fast-changing environment.
• Fluent English and German skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong influencing skills: You know how to secure resources from cross-functional Teams (e.g. Category Management, Shopper Marketing, Category Strategy & Planning, Brand Building, Consumer Market Insights) to identify & drive key initiatives and growth opportunities.
• Analytical and problem-solving skills: You show passion to drive data-based decisions. You are used analyzing and interpreting data (e.g. YouGov) and come up with solutions and ideas rather than indicating only issues.
• Collaboration skills: You know how to envision/engage people on different functions and levels in an international environment.
• Negotiation skills: You take a leading role in preparing, running the annual negotiations. Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills with a proven ability to deliver mutually beneficial business outcomes.
• eCommerce: You learn, develop and deploy state-of-the-art knowledge and skills to develop business seamlessly, with clear omni-channel mindset.

ARE YOU INTERESTED?

Please apply via this portal as e-mail applications will not be processed. By applying to this role, you are confirming that you have informed your Line Manager and that you are at a point in your career with Unilever where it is appropriate for you to be applying for other positions.   

We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment journey. Should you require additional information or reasonable adjustments to allow you to present your best self during this process, please contact your Talent Partner.
